text:
Marta: Quick sync request — we need to lock the enterprise compliance roadmap items for the Q3 pilot: audit schema, retention tiers, BYOK handshake, and SOC2 evidence packaging. Who's available to scope acceptance criteria today?
Alex P: I can do 30m. main thing: define export schema & search SLA for customer audits.
Sarah (Sec): +1. Also need KMS attestation flow and what we log for key rotation events.
Dilip: For retention tiers we should model cost impact: hot (30d), warm (1y), cold (7y). Need numbers for token storage and index size.
Kevin (Sales): P0 asks from customers: downloadable compressed evidence (tl;dr format), chain-of-custody metadata, and an audit-run PDF. They also want an SLA that exports within 2h for litigation requests.
Marta: Good notes. Proposal: MVP acceptance = (1) audit export JSONL + PDF packaging, (2) BYOK handshake proof + KMS event logs, (3) retention policy UI + infra enforcement, (4) evidence search returning results < 15s for 30d hot tier. Thoughts?
Sarah (Sec): Love the checklist. For BYOK: must include HSM/KMS provider id, key version, and signed handshake token. Also add immutable digest for exported evidence (sha256).
Alex P: Search <15s sounds fine with current indexes for 30d, but 1y warm will need sampled indexes — we should set expectation that warm queries are async (SLAs: warm 6h).
Dilip: I'll run cost sims today: estimate index cost + archive retrieval per 100k requests. If warm async is acceptable we save ~60% on ongoing infra.
Kevin (Sales): Customers will push back on async for legal holds. Can we offer a paid uplift for faster warm retrieval?
Marta: Yes — define two tiers: standard (warm async 6h) and expedited (warm <2h for extra fee). Add to roadmap pricing doc.
Sarah (Sec): Also carve out SOC2-specific deliverables: mapping of our log types to common control points, evidence bundles per control id, and signed timestamps.
Alex P: Could use an opt-in manifest that maps exported evidence to SOC2 control ids, so audits are reproducible.
Dilip: Technical constraint: keeping manifest with per-request KV metadata increases storage by ~8-12%. Call it out in tradeoffs.
Marta: Action items: Dilip -> cost sims & size delta (due EOD), Alex -> export schema + sample JSONL + SLA matrix (tomorrow), Sarah -> BYOK handshake spec & signed digest format (tomorrow), Kevin -> customer impact matrix + pricing uplift proposal (EOW). I'll consolidate into an acceptance checklist for the pilot.
Kevin (Sales): One more ask from legal teams: evidence redaction options for PII before export. Is that in scope?
Sarah (Sec): Redaction is out-of-scope for MVP; we can add as a non-blocking enhancement but we must document it for legal.
Marta: Noted. We'll include a risk note.
OpsBot: Reminder: quarterly compliance backlog grooming at 14:00 today.
Alex P: I'll join the grooming. Also suggest we add a canary export test to the console to validate export integrity on deploys.
Dilip: Agree. Canary + checksum verification reduces incident windows.
Marta: Great. If nobody objects I'll collapse these into a PR for the roadmap doc and tag PO owners. :thumbsup:
Kevin (Sales): No objections. Thanks all.
Sarah (Sec): Thanks.
Marta: Closing thread — will post consolidated checklist in #product later today.
